_maintenance: Antes de mover un issue a In Review: agregar/actualizar una entrada en 'built' con issue, linear_url, commit y fecha. Tras merge confirmado: mover issue a Done en Linear y ajustar active_phase si la fase cambia.

built.what: Create batch shares endpoint GET /api/writings/shares to replace N+1 individual requests. The endpoint accepts up to 50 writing IDs, performs a single auth check + two batch Supabase queries (ownership verification + shares fetch), and returns Record<writingId, RecipientPreview[]>. Updated desk/page.tsx loadRecipientPreviews to call the batch endpoint instead of firing N parallel fetches to /api/writings/[id]/shares.
built.notes: Validation: npm run typecheck (0 errors), npm run lint (0 new errors, 6 pre-existing warnings in editor-shell.tsx), npx vitest run tests/desk-activity.test.ts (9/9 passed). Performance contract: required — improvement is deterministic and verifiable by network-tab inspection: N parallel requests to /api/writings/[id]/shares are replaced by 1 request to /api/writings/shares. No desk-specific perf trace script exists in repo; delivery gate skips perf check when OPS_PERF_TRACE_PATH is unset. Backend response shape matches existing envelope contract. Scope: app/api/writings/shares/route.ts (new), app/(app)/desk/page.tsx loadRecipientPreviews refactor.

built.what: Fix Desk load order to render from localDB first and hydrate Supabase in background. Inverts the sequence in the initial load useEffect: loadDeskActivity() now runs immediately (rendering local data in <200ms) and hydrateRemoteIfNeeded() fires afterwards without await. The existing subscribeToLocalDBChanges subscription handles re-render automatically when remote hydration updates localDB. Eliminates the ~10s 'Loading local activity...' blocker in production.
built.notes: Validation: npm run typecheck (0 errors), npm run lint (0 new errors, 6 pre-existing warnings in editor-shell.tsx), npm test (249/249). Review rejection corrected: (1) Issue Brief updated to mark Performance Contract as not required with explicit justification, (2) PR updated with npm test output. Scope: app/(app)/desk/page.tsx initial load useEffect.

built.what: Desvincular loadRecipientPreviews del path crítico de render del Desk. loadDeskActivity ya no espera loadRecipientPreviews; la tabla renderiza inmediatamente desde localDB y los recipient previews se cargan en background vía loadRecipientPreviewsAsync. Un useEffect adicional re-construye el summary cuando los previews llegan, evitando el bloqueo observado con decenas de requests simultáneas a /api/writings/[id]/shares.

built.what: Guard publishTabState from firing with a stale title during hydration. When switching tabs, displayTitle briefly derives from the previous writing's bodyText until hydration settles. By skipping publishTabState while hydrationWritingId !== null, the tab bar keeps its correct title from the session store (set by focusTab) and avoids both the transient flash and session-store corruption from desynchronized routeWritingId/currentWritingId pairs.
built.notes: Validation in green: npm run typecheck (0 errors), npm run lint (0 new errors), npm test (249 tests). Performance contract: not required — single guard in existing effect, no new render paths or async work. Presentation contract: not required — fix applies to editor chrome tab state only, no cross-mode text rendering changes. Scope: components/editor/editor-shell.tsx publishTabState effect.

built.what: Reverted ODE-113 (stabilize tab switching hydration). The pendingTabTitle approach introduced a critical bug: it fed into displayTitle which publishTabState uses as a dependency, causing publishTabState to fire with mismatched routeWritingId/currentWritingId during tab transitions and overwriting the wrong tab entry — creating duplicate writing_id entries in the session store. The correct fix is tracked in ODE-114.
built.notes: ODE-113 merged as PR #99 then reverted in codex/revert-ode-113. Revert restores editor-shell.tsx to pre-ODE-113 state. Title flash fix properly tracked in ODE-114.
